v1 · reading journey
live capture · 2026-07-28 · geng preset · 390×844
● not mockups — the running app
Method
Every frame below is a Playwright capture of the running app (tools/capture-reading-screens.mjs — dev hooks __seedData('geng') / __goto, reduced motion for settled ceremony frames). Re-run the tool after any UI change and re-embed; a stale frame here is a hard-rule violation. Percentages shown are the live geng chart (23/33/33/6/5) — the benchmark's demo chart (40/30/20/10/0) differs by data, not design. Component names follow the frozen registry (Library_Components §0).
§1

The ceremony & the catalogue

Reveal → the four catalogue beats (C1–C7), closed and open states.
01 · reveal
The Reveal — settled frame
Ceremonial grounds (peaks + island + fog band), the painting, the name, kicker, manifesto with seal-red rule, cast line, swipe affordance. First-run only; ≈2.6s cascade lands here.
frozen board 01 · ten named parts
02 · app-reading
C1 identity hero + C2 wheel
Kicker, hero seal 46, walnut archetype, seal-red rule + manifesto, keyword chips, icon-only share + read circle; the energy wheel beneath — Core crowned, pips seated.
.idhero[data-hero=chop] · .wheel
03 · scrolled
C3 Folio + C4 catalyst | friction
Folded core-diagnosis card with ?-circle; SEEK THESE / SKIP THESE boxes with sentence rows on the locked 38px grid, bloom halos behind each row.
.insc[data-ins=folio] · .vx-pair
04 · scrolled
C5 towers + C7 wordsnote
The five energy pills as the closed relation string, shelf hint beneath, taught-word chips ending the page (R3-1 order), icons-only tab bar.

Energy pill — expanded card
All nine locked fields live: art wash, sign + eyebrow, dominance bar + %, definition line, explanation, diagnosis with remedy chip, role chip, keyword chips, black read circle. Siblings collapse to 34px.

06 · folio open
Folio — unfolded
Inscription lines ink in per line (80/340/600ms), taught words underlined in metal, chevron rotated 180°.
.folio-open · fold 240ms

§3

The D13 depth routes (.reading)

The second live implementation — energy map, FACES prologue, day master, pillars. Carries parts the benchmark retired (flagged).
Drift flag
These routes still render the benchmark-retired pill parts (.sp-rg corner role rings, .sp-hook glance label — "do not port") and their own shelf spec (radius 14 collapsed, 32px). Live-but-superseded, pending port to the locked tile. Documented as-rendered per the hard rule.
